---------------------------------- **LIMITED ACCESS** ---------------------------

**(Opens only on weekends)**

You're a tiny bear. This is a fairy tale. Nothing is normal here.

Step into storybook worlds as a mischievous little beast on a mission: swallow every magical tink you can find, outrun your rivals, and flush yourself to glory. This is Fabula!

# 🍖 LOOT = FOOD

Every tink you steal is a snack. Every boss you rob is a meal. Stuff your belly, grow your greed, and whatever you do — don't stop eating.

# 🚽 FEELING FULL? LOOK FOR A TOILET!

Hunt down the nearest extraction toilet, flush yourself through, and cash out your haul as Fame. Hang around too long and you'll lose it all.

# ⚔️ FRENEMIES

Team up, share the spoils, then think twice before you do. Up to 10 players share one world — and your best friend is one legendary artifact away from becoming your worst enemy.

# 🎡 SPIN THE WHEEL

Spin the wheel and let luck decide! Bonus loot, wild relics, weapons, or an amusing cosmetic. Fortune favors the greedy. Usually.
